hypothesis: Replace worst single-cell mean danger with the expected worst lethal opportunity over all first enemy ray contacts under a uniform remaining-army prior.
prior: Uniform rank assignments to concealed enemy squares, conditional on exact remaining rank counts and public moved status. Concealed moved squares are mobile; unmoved squares may be mobile, Bomb or Flag. Behavior and narrower battle candidate masks are omitted.

definitions.H: Number of concealed mobile enemy ranks remaining.
definitions.U: Number of concealed unmoved enemy squares at the current ai_move root.
definitions.I: Concealed Bomb count plus concealed Flag count.
definitions.D: Number of concealed mobile ranks whose attacks defeat the evaluated own rank; equal exchanges contribute zero net material loss.
definitions.subset: One nonempty subset of at most four first enemy contacts along cardinal rays.
definitions.b: Selected contacts that have not publicly moved.

derivation: An unmoved pool of U squares contains exactly U-I mobile pieces. For any b distinct selected unmoved squares, probability all are mobile is fall(U-I,b)/fall(U,b). Moved squares are already conditioned mobile.
Conditional on mobile status, ranks at selected mobile squares are sampled uniformly without replacement from H concealed mobile ranks.
A distant enemy can attack only if it is a Scout. If Scout cannot defeat the own rank, every subset containing a distant contact has zero lethal intersection probability.
Assign the f distant contacts Scout ranks first, with factor fall(S,f)/fall(H,f). These Scouts are lethal in the eligible case, consuming f of the D lethal ranks.
Assign the n adjacent contacts any remaining lethal ranks: factor fall(D-f,n)/fall(H-f,n). Combining factors gives fall(S,f)*fall(D-f,n)/fall(H,f+n).
Multiply the unmoved eligibility and rank factors. Inclusion-exclusion over at most15 nonempty subsets yields the probability that at least one enemy has an immediate lethal attack.

Every lethal attack loses the evaluated own piece worth, while the opponent can execute at most one attack. Expected worst lethal loss is worth times that union probability. A disclosed certain killer returns worth directly.
implementation: AI_EXACT_CONTACT_RISK, Classic-only, default off; Q22 probability arithmetic, no floating point, heap allocations or extra rollout worlds. Material scores round to nearest integer.
root_inventory: H,U,I and rank counts are frozen by survey for each ai_move root. Candidate occupancy changes identify contacts without changing the unconditional root inventory. Each simulated rollout ai_move performs its own survey.
limits: The formula is exact under its specified uniform moved-status prior, not under the complete public-history posterior.
The native implementation has bounded fixed-point error; independent enumeration quantifies it in exact-contact-risk-audit.json.
Opponent two-squares restrictions are ignored, matching the old danger routine.
Speculative unknown-capture survival branches retain unconditional root rank counts, rather than conditioning on the hypothetical survival.
This is mathematical mechanism evidence. Strength requires separately registered immutable policies and fresh tournaments.
